_comment: Shrink-only surviving-mutant ratchet for the mutation gate (issue #431).
Entries may only decrease. Raising one is a blocked change: it converts a
test-quality regression into a new normal. Enforced by
scripts/check_mutation.py; see docs/runbooks/mutation-testing.md.
Re-acquired 2026-08-22 (#434): the prior baseline dated 2026-08-06
covered a single module (`migration/derivation.py` = 38 survivors on
linux-x86_64 WSL) plus four `awaiting_acquisition` markers that the
scheduled CI mutation job never filled in. The CI workflow has been
broken since PR #545 set `distributor = "http"` against unix-socket
worker URLs (cosmic-ray 8.4.6's `http.py:67` raises
`NonHttpUrlClientError` on the unix:// scheme) and again since PR
#510 bumped cosmic-ray to 8.7.0; the cron ran but produced no
results, so the markers silently aged past their 14-day grace
period and started failing `test_mutation_baseline_marks_*` in
the PR-side test job. PRs #588 (marker reset), #590 (Python 3.12
pin for cosmic-ray 8.4.6), #592 (cosmic-ray 8.4.6 pin to match the
workflow), #593 (rollback to the local distributor and 6h
timeout), and #594 (stop overriding the distributor name in the
per-run renderer) compose the fix. This commit is the first
successful session since 2026-08-06, run on the production ARM64
self-hosted runner (`apap-coolify-noble-3`, Linux ARM64
Oracle VPS) so the numbers are immediately comparable to whatever
the next scheduled run produces on the same host.
Numbers shrank across the board versus the prior baseline —
`migration/derivation.py` 38 → 3 reflects the test expansion that
landed between #510 and today (the 167-mutant pilot is now 77
mutants because tests catch more, not because the surface shrank).
`migration/diff_engine.py` was a brand-new entry, never measured.
`app/core/local_backend.py` had 1 INCOMPETENT out of 300 mutants (a
crash under mutation, not a survivor) — well under the 20%
ceiling `scripts/check_mutation.py` aborts on. The BitOr filter
is still required: 308 of 1422 generated mutants are skipped
(21.7%), almost entirely the PEP 604 annotation mutations that
`from __future__ import annotations` makes unkillable.
Future acquisitions must run on the same Linux ARM64 runner (any
branch of `apap-coolify-noble-*` on the Oracle VPS) so the
platform field stays accurate and the ratchet stays comparable.
Re-measuring on x86_64 WSL would invalidate the numbers.
